subject: Hosted evaluation: pilot scope, prefetch & rateplaybook
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@datnova.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation — post-demo recap & quickstart asks

Hi Liam — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and recommended immediate path so we can get a hosted pilot moving fast: 

Summary from the call:
- Primary goal: customer-facing answer-generation on support flows (~50–150 qps at peak; median 8–12 tokens output)
- Data sensitivity: product metadata only (no PII); will want enterprise logging but not full on-prem for initial test
- Timeline: want a 1–2 week pilot to validate latency and cost before deciding on Dedicated/VPC

Our recommendation:
1) Start with a Redwood Hosted API pilot (sandbox endpoints) — fastest path to validate latency and burst behavior.
2) Configure a lightweight prefetch/KV cache profile for common prompts to reduce token spend and improve p50 latency.
3) Set conservative read-rate caps for the pilot (suggested: 100 rps steady, 250 rps burst) and we can tune based on telemetry.

What we need from you to provision the pilot:
- Confirm expected peak concurrent requests and a realistic QPS spike pattern (right now we noted 50–150 qps)
- Typical prompt + response size (max tokens per request) — will drive endpoint sizing and rate bands
- Any firm data residency or PCI/SOC constraints for the pilot
- Procurement contact (I've cc'd procurement if useful)

Attached: Hosted-Quickstart-Plan.pdf (pilot tasks + timeline) and endpoint-matrix.csv (example endpoint mapping and suggested rate bands).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the three items above by EOD tomorrow
- We provision sandbox endpoints and shared telemetry dashboard (ETA 48 hours after confirmation)
- Kick off pilot window: target May 20–27

If the pilot shows fast p50 and acceptable cost, we can discuss a short Dedicated proof-of-concept or add a VPC path if you need stricter network boundaries.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15 min follow-up if you want to walk through the quickstart doc.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Hosted-Quickstart-Plan.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: endpoint-matrix.csv (CSV)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@datnova.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — post-demo recap & quickstart asks

Thanks Chloe — great demo, appreciate the clarity. Quick answers: 
- Peak: we usually see short spikes up to 120 qps on marketing days; baseline for the feature will be ~40–60 qps. Concurrency around 90–130 during spikes.
- Tokens: typical prompt 120–250 tokens, expected response average 100 tokens, max might hit ~600 on complex threads.
- Residency: US only for now, but EU requirements may come later.
- Procurement: procurement@datnova.io is the right inbox (cc'd on this message).

We are comfortable starting on Hosted for the pilot — please send sandbox endpoints and an estimated pilot cost. Also confirm the suggested rate bands and any hard throttles we should expect so we can plan client-side retry logic.

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product, DataNova

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted evaluation — DataNova pilot ask (internal)

Ben / Kimberly — forwarding Liam's replies and the pilot asks. Key operational items for us to act on: 

Action items for Redwood ops/pricing:
- Ben: can you produce a short pilot quote for a 1-week hosted sandbox window that covers estimated throughput up to 150 qps and token profile (avg response 100 tokens, occasional 600 tokens)? We should include a burst allowance and a list price + a pilot discount.
- Kimberly: can you confirm whether we can provision sandbox endpoints in the us-east region with logging enabled to the customer dashboard (no PII collection)? Also need a note on monitoring retention for pilot telemetry.
- I'll prepare the MAP_Draft_DN.pdf (high-level mutual action plan) and share with procurement.

Notes to include in the pilot config: 
- Suggested rate caps: steady 100 rps, burst 250 rps; auto-fallback to a smaller model if we detect sustained latency > 300ms p95.
- Prefetch / KV cache recommended for top-10 prompts (I'll include an initial list in the MAP).

I want this ready to hand to procurement by tomorrow afternoon.

—Chloe
[attachment: MAP_Draft_DN.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted evaluation — DataNova pilot ask (internal)

Sounds good — I'll get a pilot quote together today. Preliminary notes:
- Pilot pricing: estimate $4,500/week for the described throughput with a 20% pilot discount (finalize after runbook checks).
- I'll ask infra to spin up sandbox endpoints in us-east and add the logging hook to the telemetry dashboard. Expect ETA ~48 hours to provision once infra has the request.

Kimberly — if you can confirm retention and log access constraints, I'll include those in the quote.

Thanks — Ben

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted evaluation — DataNova pilot ask (internal)

Ben / Chloe — quick clarification from ops side: for the pilot we can enable request/response telemetry with 30-day retention by default. If the customer wants extended retention we can add an add-on. We will not ingest or store any raw PII fields unless explicitly enabled and signed off.

Also recommend we flag this as an SLA-awareness pilot (no formal SLA until after capacity sizing) and provide a monitoring runbook for DataNova's SREs. I can draft the runbook template and attach it to the MAP.

—Kim

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@datnova.io>, Procurement <procurement@datnova.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — pilot provisioning & next steps

Liam / procurement — quick update and concrete next steps: 

What Redwood will deliver:
- Sandbox endpoints in us-east (non-prod) with telemetry dashboard and request/response logging (30d retention). ETA: 48 hours from Ben's provisioning request (target May 19).
- Pilot rate bands: steady 100 rps, burst 250 rps. We'll surface hard throttles in the API response headers and provide client retry guidance.
- Mutual Action Plan (attached) with pilot tasks and success criteria; suggested pilot window May 20–27.

What we need from DataNova:
- Procurement approval on pilot quote (Ben to follow up with formal PDF)
- Confirmation on token max (Liam noted up to ~600 tokens) — we'll size endpoints accordingly

Proposed schedule:
- May 19: sandbox endpoints provisioned
- May 20–27: pilot window (telemetry live)
- May 28: 30 min review + decision call to decide next steps (Dedicated vs VPC vs continue Hosted)

Liam — does that timeline work for you? If yes, I'll loop in procurement with Ben's quote once it's ready.

Thanks all — Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
